name: Hybrid Strategy for Interactive High Resolution Isosurface Ray Tracing
aliases: Object-order projection with restricted ray tracing
definition: A method for interactive rendering of isosurfaces using ray tracing on multi-core processors. It combines an object-order traversal to coarsely identify candidate 3D data blocks for contiguous pixels with an isosurface ray casting strategy tailored for limited-size lists of these blocks. It uses dynamic allocation of ray casting tasks to ensure load balancing and spatial locality while minimizing memory hierarchy overhead.
